source.title: c2-codex-human: aggiungere la spiegazione on-demand dei messaggi visibili
source.objective: Extend c2-codex-human with an on-demand explanation mode. Press e to select the newest visible message, navigate with Up/Down, show temporary numeric shortcuts on visible messages, Enter explains the selected message using minimal nearby context, render the explanation inline, cache by message hash, and make zero model calls during normal viewing.
source.next_action: Reassess after Symphony acquisition/migration scope is decided; resume only if the capability remains necessary outside Symphony.
